title: Authority & Handoff Contract
selected_by_owner: 2026-09-20 owner approval replacing terminal MVPS persistent lane

selection_basis.replacement_rule: OARC replaces MVPS as the third OPS3 persistent implementation lane; completed MVPS remains immutable history.
selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MSAS remains terminal completed_verified; MRCS-16 remains independently selected_not_started.

objective: Durably freeze the owner-boundary and handoff contract for operational-asset game readiness so subsequent vehicle, mecha, ship and base closure work cannot duplicate or preempt MRCS-13, MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014/D17, MERA or MBES authority.
acceptance: MRCS-13 remains reusable definition-authoring authority and no parallel modular grammar is introduced.
MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014/D17 remain operational configuration and live Asset authorities.
MERA engineering topology/refit/network/diagnostic authority is explicitly reserved rather than preimplemented.
MBES built-environment construction/room/network/settlement authority is explicitly reserved rather than preimplemented.
The OARC-02 through OARC-07 readiness sequence is bounded to bridges, normalization, profiles, containment proof, golden cases and coverage certification.
boundaries: MVPS completed history is preserved and not reopened.
OARC is a readiness/certification lane, not a new canonical runtime family.
MSAS and MRCS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-01, its declared owner-contract dependency closure and ops3-lane-state/oarc, then execute the complete bounded tranche under OPS3 milestone-only execution.
